method: scripts/qa/sweep-eye-clearance-spots.ts (legality = static + interactive-world runtime colliders) then sweep-eye-clearance-live.mjs (traceBallistics probes vs canonical shot surfaces)

accepted.rows: wallbang-panel glass (0.052 m) and brick (0.000 m), crouch
accepted.reason: The panels are authored solid:false, shots:true - deliberately walk-through range fixtures you shoot targets through. A player standing inside one clips by design; making them movement-solid would change what the range IS. Accepted, not deferred.

Escalator flank fringe: eye 11 mm inside the near-plane+bob margin beside the sloped belly. Real but sub-centimetre-class; fixing means reshaping the rotated stair collider. Deferred with numbers, revisit on any player report.

accepted.rows: stern-engine-access ramp x2, stand, 0.096 m at (±0.90, 22.15)
accepted.reason: Ramp edge fringe: 0.096 m clears the bare 0.08 m near plane and only enters the margin with full bob amplitude. Deferred with numbers.

accepted.rows: greenhouse-shot-pane-0 x8 (crouch, d=0.000 hugging x=-29.93) + pane-5 x1
accepted.reason: Authored shot-only glass with no movement collider - the greenhouse is walk-through by design (traversal pins protect that). Standing at the pane plane clips inherently, same class as the gun-range wallbang panels.

accepted.rows: exterior-access-ramp x12 + interior-access-ramp x3 (d=0.028-0.142, all stances)
accepted.reason: Sub-15 cm flank/underside fringe beside the house ramps, pre-existing visually and newly measurable now the ramps are registered with true rotation. A geometry fix means clearance pads on ramp flanks, which is navigation-coupled (ramp-foot anchors and traversal gates live exactly there) - deferred with numbers, revisit on any player report.

rebaseline: 2026-08-29: atomic-acres 0 -> 24. NOT a game regression - an instrument-vision correction. The probe sees only REGISTERED shot surfaces; the ballistic-parity lane closed 22 ghost meshes the same night, so surfaces that always existed visually (house access ramps, greenhouse panes) became measurable for the first time. The other four arenas were unchanged (3/0/2/2), which is the control that separates new sight from new damage.
